anti_leakage_rules: No pre-launch observation may be scored as Arc production activity.
Named partners count as one announcement cluster until independent operational evidence exists.
TVL, transaction count, fees and settlement volume are separate dimensions and may not substitute for each other.
No baseline supplied by the research agent is canonical until reproduced by an approved collector.
Missing data is UNKNOWN, never zero.
Incentive-driven deposits must be separated from non-incentivized capital.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: Arc public mainnet is live no later than 14 days after the stated 2026-09-16 date.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: Verified public RPC, explorer and reproducible finalized blocks are available.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.fail_condition: No verified public mainnet by deadline.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: At least 8 of 11 announced external founding validators produce blocks within 30 days of verified launch.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: At least 8 named external validators have reproducible block-production evidence.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: No announced founding validator publicly withdraws before 2026-12-31.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.fail_condition: At least one verified withdrawal or explicit non-participation statement.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: Arc TVL reaches at least USD 200M by day 90.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: Reproducible TVL at or above USD 200M with chain definition and duplicate-asset treatment documented.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.fail_condition: TVL below USD 200M or no reproducible chain index.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.warning: TVL is not equivalent to payment or settlement volume.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: Arc daily fees reach at least USD 5000 by day 60.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: Seven-day median daily fees at or above USD 5000 using a documented fee definition.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: BUIDL is deployed on Arc by 2026-12-31.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: Verified Arc contract and issuer confirmation with nonzero supply.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.fail_condition: No verified deployment or zero supply.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: USDC circulation is not below the validated 2026-08-05 baseline at 2026-12-31.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: Year-end USDC circulation is at or above the validated baseline.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.fail_condition: Year-end USDC circulation is below the validated baseline.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: Circle National Trust is operational by 2026-09-30.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: OCC or Circle explicitly confirms operating commencement and service scope.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.fail_condition: No verified operating commencement by deadline.

promotional_dominant_falsifiers.claim: USDC reserve management has moved materially to Circle National Trust by 2027-06-30.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.pass_condition: Official attestation identifies Circle National Trust as reserve manager or custodian for a material share.
promotional_dominant_falsifiers.fail_condition: Reserve-management role remains future, immaterial or absent.

structural_confirmation_conditions.claim: Arc TVL exceeds USD 1B by day 120 without above-market incentive dependence.
Arc appears as an independently identified chain in Visa Onchain Analytics by 2027-03-31.
USDC circulation exceeds USD 85B while total stablecoin supply is rising by 2026-12-31.
At least three announced validators publish actual non-pilot settlement volume on Arc by 2027-06-30.
Circle National Trust manages at least 50 percent of the USDC reserve by 2027-12-31.
